## Industrial problem

What real problem should the agent be able to help solve?

## Who has this problem?

Describe the type of user, facility, machine, or workflow without identifying a customer or site.

## Why is a reusable skill useful?

What does a general-purpose coding agent usually misunderstand or miss here?

## Expected agent behavior

What should the agent inspect, verify, avoid assuming, or validate?

## Relevant technologies

Examples: PLCs, MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus, PROFINET, containers, machine vision, historian data, condition monitoring.

## Public sources

If the request depends on vendor-specific behavior, include public documentation or open-source references where possible.

## Confidentiality check

Do not include customer names, identifying project details, real site IP addresses or hostnames, credentials, proprietary code, private process data, internal-only vendor documentation, or other confidential information.

- [ ] I reviewed this request for confidential or identifying information.
